## Intent

Which decision or section of [PLAN.md](../PLAN.md) this serves, in one or two sentences.

## Change

What is added, changed or removed. Name the tests that were written first.

## How to verify locally

The commands a reviewer runs, and what they should see.

## Deployment impact

None, or the resources created, changed or removed, and the environment where this was
deployed before review.

## Where to look first

The one or two files that carry the idea; the rest follows from them.

## Stack

- Base: the pull request this one builds on, or `main`.
- Next: the pull request that builds on this one, if already open.
- Size: hand-written lines changed. If above 250, why it could not be split.
